001: Ivan, did you see the email from the marketing department? They're asking us to clarify details about the project.
Yes, Anna, I already read it. I think we need to reply today so we don't hold them up.
I agree. I prepared a draft of the reply, but I'm not sure about the deadlines.
Let's look at it together. I was just confirming the schedule with the manager.
Great. Then I'll send the final version after our discussion.
Okay. Just, please, add the information about the budget, they were asking about that.
002: Dmitry, did you get my email from yesterday with the report?
Yes, I got it, thanks. I looked it over, but I have a couple of questions about the numbers.
Which ones exactly? I can explain or fix it if something is wrong.
The sales figure for the third quarter threw me off. It seems too high.
I'll check the data again and send you the revised version by the evening.
I'll be waiting. If it's difficult, we can have a call tomorrow morning.
003: Sergey, the colleagues from the branch office sent a request for a joint presentation.
I saw it. They want us to prepare the slides by Friday.
That's doable if we split the tasks. I'll take the analytics, and you take the design.
Deal. But let's decide right away who will send the final file.
I can send it, but you'll check your part first.
Of course. I'll finish by Thursday and send it to you for approval.
004: Elena, did you see the email from the new partner? They're proposing to change the terms of the contract.
Yes, I was just reading it. The proposal is interesting, but there's a risk with the delivery deadlines.
I think so too. We need to discuss this with the lawyer before we reply.
Agreed. I already wrote to the lawyer, I'm waiting for his comment.
Then let's wait for his response and prepare a joint objection.
Great. I'll draft it, and you can check the wording afterwards.
005: Ivan, did you reply to the request from accounting? They're waiting for confirmation of the payment.
Not yet, I wanted to check one thing with you before sending it.
Sure, go ahead. What exactly are you wondering about?
They're asking for the invoice number, but I couldn't find it in our documents.
Let me look for it now. I think it was in the last email from the finance department.
Thanks. If you find it, I'll send them a reply right away.
006: Dmitry, could you forward me the email with the meeting schedule?
Yes, of course. I'll send it to you in a couple of minutes.
Thanks. And have you already confirmed your attendance at tomorrow's conference?
Not yet, I was waiting for clarification on the presentation from our manager.
I see. Then I won't confirm my attendance yet either, so we can act together.
Good idea. As soon as I get the information, I'll write to you right away.
007: Olga, did you see that the client sent a complaint about the quality of our services?
Yes, I saw it. This is a serious problem, we need to respond as quickly as possible.
I prepared a draft response, but I want you to check the tone of it.
Let me take a look. The main thing is that we acknowledge the problem, but don't take on extra blame.
That's exactly why I wrote it neutrally, without any specific promises.
Good. I'll tweak the wording a bit and get it back to you today.
008: Sergey, do you know who's in charge of sending out the weekly report?
I think it's Maria from our department. She usually sends it out on Fridays.
I see. I'll write to her and ask her to add me to the recipient list.
Better to ask the manager first, so we don't break any rules.
You're right, I'll check with him. Thanks for the tip.
No problem. If you need anything else, just ask.
009: Anna, did you get the invitation to the online meeting from the project team?
Yes, I got it. But the meeting time isn't very convenient for me, I have classes.
That's too bad. Maybe we can ask to move it an hour later?
I can write to the organizer and suggest a different time.
That would be great. Just check if it works for the other participants.
Of course. I'll send the email and let you know how it goes.
010: Ivan, did you forget to send the documents to the archive, like the boss asked?
No, I already sent them in the morning. But I didn't get a confirmation that they received them.
That's strange. Maybe we should write to them again and check?
Yeah, I was just about to. I'll write to them this afternoon.
Okay. If there are any problems, let me know, I'll help you sort it out.
Thanks, Anna. I hope it all gets resolved quickly.
